title: Thamizh
desc: Following an altercation with some dangerous goons, a man confronts a gangster and joins hands with his adversary to defeat him.

title: En Bommukutti Ammavukku
desc: Vinod and Lakshmi, who lost their daughter in an accident, adopt Tinu, a vivacious young girl, from an orphanage. However, the family faces challenges when Tinu's birth parents set out to find her.

title: Uzhavan
desc: A young farmer is conscious of his looks and is unable to marry due to his insecurities. But a young woman teaches him that love is based on more than just physical attraction.

title: En Rajangam
desc: Gopalakrishnan, an innocent police constable, gets into trouble when he is falsely accused of killing his sister's mother-in-law.

title: Sundara Kandam
desc: Priya, a young student, falls in love with her teacher, a man who shows no interest in her. Complications arise when the professor gets married, and she continues to stir trouble in his life.
